question: At the first geometry-stop edge, does direct depth PnP recover a valid same-edge local motion when the unchanged Fundamental-MAGSAC-plus-PnP primary rejects?
selection_rule: all 14 formal route-tangent episodes whose terminal partition was post_accept_geometry_stream_failure
control_contract: the primary estimator alone determines motion and termination; the shadow is computed after it and is receipt-only
diagnostic_outputs: PnP status, inliers and reprojection RMSE
shadow planar-motion error against the already-executed evaluator pose interval
whether the original typed geometry stop is reproduced

decision_rule.supports_epipolar_degeneracy: the unfiltered shadow is valid on at least 10 of 14 reproduced primary-stop edges and its median translation error is at most 0.10 m and median yaw error is at most 5 degrees
decision_rule.rejects_simple_epipolar_explanation: fewer than 10 of 14 reproduced primary-stop edges have a valid and geometrically accurate unfiltered shadow
